name: Nitro tech Protine Shake
ingredients_raw: Protein Blend (86%) (Whey Protein Concentrate, Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Peptides), Creatine Monohydrate, Cocoa (Processed with Alkali), Natural and Artificial Flavours (Chocolate, Vanilla), Soy or Sunflower Lecithin (Emulsifier), Gum Blend (Cellulose Gum [Stabilizer], Xanthan Gum [Emulsifier], Carrageenan [Emulsifier]), Sweeteners (Sucralose, Acesulfame-Potassium), Salt (Flavour Enhancer).
